editorial: You follow Cris Johnson, a Vegas magician who can see a few minutes ahead. He hides from government and doctors, living on small tricks and gambling. When terrorists threaten LA with a nuke, agent Callie Ferris hunts him down to help. The movie mixes action, sci-fi, and thriller with a playful Vegas energy. Nicolas Cage brings charm, Julianne Moore adds grit, and the action moves fast. The future-seeing scenes are fun, though the plot can feel silly and the romance rushed. If you want light popcorn action, it works well. Stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Cris uses his visions to dodge the terrorists, save Liz, and guide Ferris to the bomb before it explodes. The twist is that much of the danger plays out through possible futures he tests, and the ending shows him choosing the path where he and Liz survive while the attack is stopped. You see him finally accept helping others instead of hiding. The last shot leaves him with Liz, safe and free.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mind-bending action and Nicolas Cage charm.
